row.notes: Equality of two user-id records, bool(a, b) in al; it writes neither. With equal type bytes (+0): type 0 is never equal, not even to another type 0 (0x144121bdf); type 3 compares the +0x38 bytes when either is non-zero and otherwise the XOR-folded ids [+8]^[+0x10] (0x144121bfa); every other type, 7 included, needs equal folded ids and equal +0x39 bytes (0x144121f15..0x144121f35). With different type bytes (0x144121c18) the two are equal only when each equals a zero record of its own type, which it builds on the stack with fresh XOR pairs and checks by calling itself (0x144121d91, 0x144121f0a). Callers: census steam 0x4121bc0, among them the ReplicationManagers and the ElasticSearch serialiser 0x1407622c0.
